purpose: Determine scale sensitivity within a fixed retrospective T-input Atlas release; never compare absolute errors as a pure scale change from full-U entry_v1
LR_selection: per family/fold/scale by stop group_macro_H only
main_metric: mean across groups of mean across T-proteins of row Hellinger
CDF: unweighted MSE over the 62 ordered internal cutpoints; not continuous Wasserstein
tails: MAE of first and last bin probability masses, not tail conditional means
new_C_next_gate: Map new C protected groups and identities; construct fold-specific old-label initializations and compare matched random vs historical initialization
ESM3_trigger: Stable main anchors and checked local checkpoint/interface; then same-checkpoint seq-only versus seq+existing-structure subset; no full cache prerequisite
stopping: No extra architecture/loss combinations in this stage; rank scale trends and paired differences; budget stops are not scientific convergence
authorization: User-authorized bounded development training, 2026-11-05; private authorization record retained with execution artifacts
